zh: [language] 任务=沿岸巡航；优先保持干燥。

en: [action] Vision confirms traversable sand; eight legs execute lateral motion.
zh: [action] 视觉确认沙面可通行；八腿执行横移。

en: [vision] Foam enters the path ahead; contact expected.
zh: [vision] 浪花进入前方路径；预计发生接触。

en: [feedback] Water has arrived; environment vetoed the dryness constraint.
zh: [feedback] 海水已抵达；干燥约束被环境否决。

en: [policy] Track localization failed; replan from the current water surface.
zh: [policy] 足迹定位失效；根据当前水面重规划。

en: [vision] A second wave approaches; available dry ground keeps shrinking.
zh: [vision] 第二股浪花接近；可用干地继续缩小。

en: [policy] Reduce movement speed; prioritize eight-legged support.
zh: [policy] 下调移动速度；优先维持八腿支撑。

en: [action] Wade with a low posture; temporarily hand navigation to the tide.
zh: [action] 执行低姿态涉水；导航权暂交潮汐。
